messages:
Jordan L: Quick heads-up: I'm the deploy owner for runtime-service v3.2.1 -> prod, window 10:30 PT. No schema changes, mostly perf fixes + tracing tag tweaks. Can platform + oncall confirm observability preflight?

Samantha P: +1, thanks. Which dashboards did you change? I want to make sure alerts won't fire on minor metric shifts.

Jordan L: Updated two panels on runtime /latency and /kvcache-hit-rate (Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/XYz123/runtime-ops). Lowered the alert for p95 from 600->550ms for canary only. Production alert remains at 700ms.

Devon K: Can you paste the exact alert rule IDs so I can mute during the canary?

Jordan L: Rule IDs: `alert.runtime.p95.canary` and `alert.runtime.errors.canary`. I'll put the canary rule into maintenance at deploy start.

Alex R: Heads-up: I also added a small trace span rename to make frontend/backend correlation easier. Span name change might create a short-term dip in trace counts in the new dashboard tile. Not an error.

Samantha P: Ok. We'll suppress the canary p95 and errors alerts for 20 minutes starting at 10:28 PT. Oncall, please monitor error rate and 5xx logs during that period.

Maria T: Canary config: traffic 5% for first 10m, then 25% if no regressions. Auto-rollback if error rate x2 baseline for 5m. Rollforward only after manual approval.

Jordan L: Smoke checks I'm going to run immediately post-deploy. Please run them too and paste results.

Devon K: I'll run them from my laptop and from the prod probe. Commands:
```bash
# health
curl -sS https://runtime.redwood.ai/health | jq .status
# quick perf
curl -sS -H 'Authorization: Bearer $DEMO_TOKEN' -d '{"input":"hello"}' https://runtime.redwood.ai/generate | jq '.latency_ms'
```

Devon K: And a log query to look at errors:
```kql
logs | where service=="runtime-service" and timestamp > now()-15m and level=="error" | count()
```

deploy-bot: CI: runtime-service build #2389 succeeded. Integration tests: 312 passed, 0 failed. Canary image tagged: runtime:v3.2.1-canary

Samantha P: I'll keep an eye on Grafana and traces. If anything looks off I'll @jordan and start rollback.

Jordan L: Thanks. Rollback plan: rollback to runtime:v3.2.0-canary then to prod image runtime:v3.2.0. I have permissions and will execute if we hit the automated rollback or manual call.

Alex R: One extra note — sampling rate bumped from 10%->12% for traces in canary only; that'll show more spans but shouldn't alarm.

Maria T: All set from my side. Will wait for the maintenance mute window.

Devon K: Smoke results (prod probe): health=ok, generate latency ~120ms, errors=0 in last 10m. Probe from us-east also OK.

Samantha P: Grafana panels stable, p95 in canary bucket ~530ms (expected). No alert triggers. Traces show new span names.

Jordan L: Great — starting canary deploy now (10:30 PT). I'll post updates every 5m.

Samantha P: Thanks, I'll stay glued to the dashboards. :eyes:

Jordan L: 10:35 update: canary at 5% -> healthy. No errors. Keeping to 25% in 5m.

Devon K: Observability note: if anyone sees a transient spike in trace ingestion, that's the sampling bump — not a failure.

Alex R: Acknowledged.

Jordan L: 10:45 update: 25% progressive, metrics steady. No rollback needed. Proceeding to full rollout in 10m per rollout plan.

Samantha P: I'll re-enable the canary alerts after final verification.

Jordan L: Thanks everyone — tagging this thread for post-deploy follow-up on dashboard tile wording and trace doc update.

Maria T: Nice run. Adding a note to the rollout spreadsheet.

deploy-bot: Deploy: runtime-service v3.2.1 promoted to prod at 10:55 PT by Jordan L.

Jordan L: Closing thread. If any post-deploy regressions appear, open a new incident channel.
